claims.claim_text: The indexed Arlan R. Daniels is confirmed as the person recorded entering the United States Army on May 5, 1942.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact indexed private identifier selects one Army merged-file row whose name adds a second middle initial.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by the exact unique private identifier plus matching surname, given name, and first middle initial; the Army-only additional initial is preserved as a documented variant.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army-entry record is dated 5 May 1942; the OSS transfer date is unknown.
claims.match_notes: The Army row records private at entry and civilian-occupation value 999. The value is not interpreted, and the full private identifier remains private.

person_updates.identity_evidence: No reliable accessible source linked Geneva L Daniel to Box 166 or established a pre-OSS affiliation. The complete Army merged-file scan found no exact-name row.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The complete Army merged file contains six exact-name James B Daniel rows, none linked to Box 166 or a private index identifier. Five newspaper candidates were rejected; an exact-name 1948 remains-return notice supplies no OSS or second identity selector.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index identifies Major John F Daniel and preserves a literal six-digit private value. Six exact-name Army entry rows and five newspaper candidates cannot be assigned without the indexed officer identifier, Box 166 linkage, or two corroborating selectors.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The complete Army merged file contains eleven exact-name John W Daniel rows. Five newspaper candidates were token collisions or had a conflicting middle initial. No source supplies an OSS, Box 166, or second biographical selector.

person_updates.identity_evidence: One exact-name Women's Army Corps row and two full-name newspaper subjects were found, including a 1945 Arkansas school principal. None supplies a private identifier, OSS context, Box 166 link, or second corroborating selector, so no occupation is assigned.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index preserves Robert J Daniel and a literal six-digit private value. Seven exact-name Army rows cannot be assigned to it. Five newspaper results were surname, middle-initial, or token mismatches and supply no OSS or Box 166 bridge.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review Box 166 and the original service documentation to resolve the common-name candidates and establish any employer.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The index identifies First Lieutenant Edward J Danielewicz and preserves a literal seven-digit private value. The Army merged file has no exact-name row. person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review the First Lieutenant Edward J Danielewicz file in Box 166 for officer identity, unit, education, employer and OSS chronology.

person_updates.identity_evidence: No reliable accessible source linked Tatianna Daniell to Box 166 or established a pre-OSS affiliation. Exact-spelling and conservative Tatiana search variants produced no assignable candidate, and the complete Army merged-file scan found no exact-name row.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review Box 166 for original spelling, identity, nationality, occupation, employer and OSS chronology.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked OSS index and official Army merged file share Arlan R Daniels's exact private identifier, surname, given name, and first middle initial. The Army row adds a second middle initial D, dates entry to 5 May 1942 as a private, and carries occupation value 999, which remains uninterpreted.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review Box 166 for occupation, employer and Army-to-OSS chronology; do not assign meaning to value 999 without authoritative support.
